displayName: C# Windows Service / Console → .NET 10 Worker Service (Generic Host + BackgroundService) + xUnit
description: Reference scaffold for migrating Windows Services (ServiceBase), Console polling apps, and scheduled batch processors to .NET 10 Generic Host with BackgroundService. Primary target for Abaca Packaging 3000 (#14 — background DB batch processing with Actian Zen / Speedbase proprietary DB layers). Key patterns: ServiceBase.OnStart/OnStop → BackgroundService.ExecuteAsync with CancellationToken; Thread.Sleep loop → PeriodicTimer; Windows Event Log → ILogger<T> + Serilog; ConfigurationManager → IConfiguration + appsettings.json; raw ADO.NET with proprietary driver → Dapper + ODBC bridge (pending DB track) or EF Core 10. Deployable as Linux systemd service or Windows Service via UseWindowsService(). Serilog for structured logging. xUnit + TestServer for worker integration tests.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the spec's target_archetype_hint is 'WorkerService' and schemaId is 'csharp'. Primary target for Windows Services and scheduled background processors.
